label: Jett
fundamentals: Tailwind makes Jett one of the safest Operator holders: take a one-and-done angle, then dash back beside cover after the shot.
Cloudburst is a short crossing tool. Pair it with Tailwind to break one sightline, then clear the next fight instead of treating it like a full controller smoke.
Updraft and Blade Storm stay accurate while moving, so use elevation to change the defender's crosshair height only when you know where you can land.

patchHistory.note: Tailwind changed to a primed dash: after a 0.75-second delay, Jett received a 12-second window to use it.
Tailwind's window fell to 7.5 seconds with a 1-second windup; Cloudburst fell to 2.5 seconds, Updraft to one charge, and Blade Storm rose to 8 points.

abilities.name: Updraft
abilities.summary: INSTANTLY propel Jett high into the air.
abilities.purpose: Reach unexpected elevation, clear vertical utility, or combine with Blade Storm.
abilities.setup: Use it with a clear landing plan. The weapon re-equip delay makes unsupported airtime punishable.

abilities.name: Tailwind
abilities.summary: ACTIVATE to prepare a gust of wind for a limited time. RE-USE the wind to propel Jett in the direction she is moving. If Jett is standing still, she propels forward. Tailwind charge resets every two kills.
abilities.purpose: Create entry space or escape after an Operator shot or opening duel.
abilities.setup: Use the dash with a clear destination. It should end behind cover or inside a planned Cloudburst.

abilities.name: Cloudburst
abilities.summary: INSTANTLY throw a projectile that expands into a brief vision-blocking cloud on impact with a surface. HOLD the ability key to curve the smoke in the direction of your crosshair.
abilities.purpose: Break one sightline long enough to dash, cross, isolate, or retrieve the spike.
abilities.setup: Small one-ways are possible, but the short duration makes them a momentary duel tool rather than controller coverage.

abilities.name: Blade Storm
abilities.summary: EQUIP a set of highly accurate throwing knives. FIRE to throw a single knife and recharge knives on a kill. ALT FIRE to throw all remaining daggers but does not recharge on a kill.
abilities.purpose: Preserve economy, fight accurately while moving, and pair vertical movement with a weapon that stays precise.
abilities.setup: Single-fire for reliable resets. Alternate fire is a close-range commitment and does not restore knives on a kill.

abilities.name: Drift
abilities.summary: Holding the jump button while falling allows you to glide through the air.

lore.label: Origin
lore.note: Jett represents her home country with an agile, evasive fighting style built around speed and calculated risk.

lore.label: Lore
lore.note: Her supernatural command of wind lets her move through fights in ways few opponents can track, favoring precision over brute force.
